title: Arterial Road Resurfacing Program
scope: Six urban road sections milled and repaved under lane closures by one paving crew moving location to location.
assume: Six sections, 14 m wide (4 lanes), 60-80 m long; 10 m paving pulls. Mill 50 mm, base repairs, 40 mm binder + 40 mm surface.
One milling and one paving crew move section to section; traffic control is set before milling and removed at reopening.
